title: The second design's checks that need a finger on the tablet (the desk
blocker: runs there with SHOW first, every hit a bounded burst; v95 linked to the Mac mini over Wi-Fi on 2026-10-21): hold FLASH and see the light while held and the tile amber, lift and see it off; hold past eight seconds and see the master end it by itself; HUMO YA and HUMO VERT the same at five seconds; two fingers on two hits; tap a state, a colour, an ambient rhythm and OFF; TAP on the tempo card; the tab strip and the pager; the gear, Cerrar, the keyboard; the lock target in the bar. Then the durations: 8 s for the flashes and the colour hits, 4 s for the strobes and 5 s for the fog are provisional, in `BURST_MS` in qlctool's `qlctool/placement.py`. Smallest action: I at the tablet with the rig on, fifteen minutes.
